terminalCaptures.name: kubernetes-storage
pvc-persistence
terminalCaptures.command:
{
curl -fsS -X POST http://localhost:3001/api/tasks -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"title":"Foot capture - persistence","assignee":"Vedanshu","priority":"HIGH"}' | tee /tmp/labboard-foot-20261016/persistence-task.json
printf "\n"
TASK_ID=$(jq -r .id /tmp/labboard-foot-20261016/persistence-task.json)
kubectl delete pod taskboard-postgres-0 -n taskboard
kubectl rollout status statefulset/taskboard-postgres -n taskboard --timeout=180s
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/taskboard-postgres-0 -n taskboard --timeout=180s
curl -fsS -w "\n" "http://localhost:3001/api/tasks/$TASK_ID"
kubectl get pvc -n taskboard
}

terminalCaptures.name: aws-cleanup
terminalCaptures.command:
{
terraform -chdir=terraform state list | jq -R -sc '{TerraformResources:(split("\n")|map(select(length>0)))}'
aws eks list-clusters --region ap-south-1 --query '{EKSClusters:clusters[?starts_with(@, `session21-labboard`)]}' --output json | jq -c .
aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region ap-south-1 --filters Name=tag:Project,Values=LabBoard --query '{VPCs:Vpcs[].VpcId}' --output json | jq -c .
aws ecr describe-repositories --region ap-south-1 --query '{ECRRepositories:repositories[?starts_with(repositoryName, `session21-labboard`)].repositoryName}' --output json | jq -c .
aws ec2 describe-instances --region ap-south-1 --instance-ids i-050b60ab4f9df119a --query '{Worker:Reservations[].Instances[].{ID:InstanceId,State:State.Name}}' --output json | jq -c .
aws kms describe-key --region ap-south-1 --key-id 63c87520-78f7-4a67-bf8b-e0dcbaf404cd --query '{PreviousKey:{State:KeyMetadata.KeyState,DeleteAfter:KeyMetadata.DeletionDate}}' --output json | jq -c .
aws kms describe-key --region ap-south-1 --key-id 075860b1-b9c4-4c18-90da-195b659910c2 --query '{CaptureKey:{State:KeyMetadata.KeyState,DeleteAfter:KeyMetadata.DeletionDate}}' --output json | jq -c .
}

terminalCaptures.name: metrics
gitops-self-heal
terminalCaptures.command:
{
kubectl get deployment taskboard-frontend -n taskboard
kubectl scale deployment taskboard-frontend -n taskboard --replicas=1
kubectl get deployment taskboard-frontend -n taskboard
kubectl wait --for=jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}'=2 deployment/taskboard-frontend -n taskboard --timeout=180s
kubectl rollout status deployment/taskboard-frontend -n taskboard --timeout=180s
kubectl wait --for=jsonpath='{.status.health.status}'=Healthy application/labboard -n argocd --timeout=120s
kubectl get deployment taskboard-frontend -n taskboard
kubectl get application labboard -n argocd
}

terminalCaptures.name: troubleshooting-failures
terminalCaptures.command:
{
kubectl apply -f troubleshooting/broken-image.yaml -f troubleshooting/broken-service.yaml
kubectl wait --for=jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].state.waiting.reason}'=ImagePullBackOff pod -l app=broken-image -n taskboard --timeout=90s
kubectl get pods -l app=broken-image -n taskboard
kubectl get events -n taskboard --field-selector reason=Failed --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -4
kubectl get svc broken-service -n taskboard -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector}{"\n"}{.spec.ports}{"\n"}'
kubectl get endpointslices -n taskboard -l kubernetes.io/service-name=broken-service
kubectl get pods -n taskboard -l app=taskboard-backend --show-labels
}

terminalCaptures.name: troubleshooting
terminalCaptures.command:
{
kubectl get deployment taskboard-taskboard-backend -n taskboard -o json | jq '{spec:{template:{spec:.spec.template.spec}}}' | kubectl patch deployment taskboard-broken-image -n taskboard --type=merge --patch-file=/dev/stdin
kubectl rollout status deployment/taskboard-broken-image -n taskboard --timeout=120s
kubectl get pods -n taskboard -l app=broken-image
kubectl patch svc broken-service -n taskboard --type=merge -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"taskboard-backend"},"ports":[{"port":8080,"targetPort":8000}]}}'
sleep 2
kubectl get endpointslices -n taskboard -l kubernetes.io/service-name=broken-service
kubectl exec -n taskboard deployment/taskboard-taskboard-backend -c backend -- python -c 'from urllib.request import urlopen; print(urlopen("http://broken-service:8080/health", timeout=10).read().decode())'
}
